Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Heart of Darkness
Cards.Text:
Before this battle's resolution: Choose and bow zero to two cards at the current battlefield with 4 or greater Force.
Battle: If no Terrain is at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.

Cards.Name: Intimidation
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Berserker Personality and target another player's Personality not at the current battlefield: Move them both there. Straighten each unit that this moved.

Cards.Name: Never Beyond My Reach
Cards.Text: Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, choose your performing unbowed Kensai, who may be at an adjacent battlefield to the current one if he has a Weapon attached: Ranged 6 Attack (against a target at the current battlefield).

Cards.Name: Pearls & Spirits
Cards.Text:
Battle: Bow your performing Shugenja, and destroy him unless he is Nonhuman: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Force plus Chi.
Battle: Bow your performing Shugenja: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Force or Chi.

Cards.Name: Returning Home
Cards.Text: Reaction: After a battle ends in which you destroyed a province as the Attacker: Create a Holding with the trait "Bow this card: Produce 3 Gold" (it enters play bowed). Draw a card.

Cards.Name: Rise of the Dark Naga
Cards.Text: Open: If you control two or more Nonhuman Personalities, choose your performing Nonhuman Personality face-up in your province: Bring him into play, paying all costs. Refill the province face-up.

Cards.Name: Seeking the Truth
Cards.Text: Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing unbowed Scout at the current battlefield: You have Reconnaissance there. Put a non-Unique Battle Strategy in your discard pile into your hand. After this battle ends, if you did not destroy the battlefield's province or an army, discard a card at random.

Cards.Name: Siege Volley
Cards.Text:
Siege Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
Siege Absent Battle: Give the current Province a strength bonus or penalty equal to the number of Castles you control.

Cards.Name: Steadfast Defense
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Monk: Straighten him. If you control a Temple, you may target a Personality or Follower and bow or straighten it.

Cards.Name: Sundering Strike
Cards.Text: Battle: Target an enemy Personality: You may target one of his attachments and pay Gold equal to its Gold Cost minus four. If you did, destroy it. Move the Personality home.
